events.title: Stanley Threads Disabled
events.description: Omniscient disabled Stanley's auto-threads after they failed to gain traction. The associated award goal is no longer achievable; an updated AI-generated content version is planned.

events.title: Referral Program for $5 in XMR
events.description: Omniscient floated a new referral benefit: members who refer someone who upgrades to L33t would earn a monetary reward. Figures are not finalized — community input is being sought.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Flip Reaper awarded to shakur123. King Decade awarded to Wake, SIM-2327840, Pharcyde, Industry, and Top 3!. Silver Medal awarded to Vinavil.

events.title: Group & Crew Changes
events.description: Lavish Living was removed as a leader of Pink LSZ.

events.title: Hack Forums Monthly Picks
events.description: MarlboroMan launched Monthly Picks — a community voting initiative for Member of the Month, Group of the Month, and Thread of the Month — bringing back the spirit of older recognition systems in a clean, simple format.

events.title: Google AI Studio 2.0 Antigravity Coding Agent
events.description: JoseMar broke down Google's Antigravity Coding Agent — persistent project awareness, automated Firebase setup, real-time multiplayer capabilities — and discussed how the developer's role evolves as systems supervise themselves.

events.title: Building a Local Speech-to-Text API with Whisper
events.description: Yakless walked readers through building a fully local transcription API using Whisper and FastAPI, covering model choice, CPU-friendly settings, VAD filtering, timestamps, and chaining output into a broader local AI pipeline.

events.title: Claude Code adds /dream - a sleep cycle for memory
events.description: Oh_Well discussed Claude Code's new /dream feature, which periodically consolidates, prunes, and rewrites memory to combat bloat, contradiction, and noise — framing it as a meaningful step in agent design beyond longer context.

events.title: Hacknet — New Hacking MMO/Idle
events.description: purplelepro shared an early version of Hacknet — a live multiplayer MMO/idle game built around attacking targets, upgrading rigs, deploying malware-themed mechanics, and crypto mining — and asked the community for feedback.

events.title: Death Stranding 2 Giveaway - Steam Key
events.description: 7 is giving away a spare Death Stranding 2 Steam key (received bundled with a new laptop). Ends April 4.

events.title: Movie of the Week — City of God (2002)
events.description: MarlboroMan submitted City of God as Movie of the Week.
